phr-p01-v01.speaker: Kṣemarāja (sūtra voice)
phr-p01-v01.question: How does free consciousness become the bound knower?
premises: Sūtra 1: free consciousness causes the world's triple proving.
Sūtra 2: by own will on own ground she opens the world (no borrowed means).
Sūtra 3: manifoldness through fit perceiver-perceived division.
Sūtra 4: contraction of consciousness — yet a knower, world-shrunk.
phr-p01-v01.inference: Cause stated, means refused, manifold explained, veil named: descent promised.
uncertainties: viśvasiddhi gloss revised to triple process (vṛtti + Pradipaka); siddhi≠powers.

phr-p02-v05.speaker: Kṣemarāja (sūtra voice)
phr-p02-v05.question: What lies on the way down?
premises: Sūtra 5: mind — contracted consciousness.
Sūtra 6: the māyā-knower consists of that.
Sūtra 7: seven pentads — 35 stations Śiva-to-bound-soul (text does not enumerate).
Sūtra 8: all philosophies stand as stages on that descent.
phr-p02-v05.inference: Descent inventoried: mind, knower, pentads, every school seated.
uncertainties: Seven pentads unenumerated (standard Trika grouping in NOTE); schools unenumerated.

phr-p03-v09.speaker: Kṣemarāja (sūtra voice)
phr-p03-v09.question: How does the bound one still act divinely?
premises: Sūtra 9: like consciousness, impure by tightened power — a wanderer.
Sūtra 10: yet likewise does the five acts (creation/keeping/loosing/veiling/blessing).
Sūtra 11-12: those doings are wanderinghood.
phr-p03-v09.inference: Agency kept through contraction: likeness stained, five acts still done.
uncertainties: Five acts standard Trika (cf. Bodhavilāsa, Paramārthasāra); śaktisaṃkoca unspecified (citi→citta via māyā).

phr-p04-v13.speaker: Kṣemarāja (sūtra voice)
phr-p04-v13.question: How is freedom won back?
premises: Sūtra 13: by climbing to knowing's seat — knowing (method unspecified: śaktipāta + grace).
Sūtra 14: it burns knowables for fuel (malas: āṇava/māyīya/kārma).
Sūtra 15: grown strong, the world owned.
Sūtra 16: fast-held oneness-with-knowing is living freedom.
phr-p04-v13.inference: Return by recognition, not effort: climb, burn, own, hold fast.
uncertainties: Ascent-method and fuel-identity from standard Trika, marked as such.

phr-p01-v01.plain_english: Consciousness stands free — cause of the world's proving.

phr-p01-v02.plain_english: By her own will, on her own ground, she opens the world.

phr-p01-v03.plain_english: That grows manifold through fit perceivers and perceived dividing.

phr-p01-v04.plain_english: A contraction of knowing, yet a knower even so, clothed in a contracted world.

phr-p02-v08.plain_english: Stages on that — every philosophy's standing-ground.

phr-p03-v09.plain_english: Like knowing, yet by tightened power impure — stained, it wanders.

phr-p03-v10.plain_english: Yet even so, likewise, it does the five acts.

phr-p04-v13.plain_english: By climbing to knowing's seat — knowing.

phr-p04-v15.plain_english: Grown strong, it makes the world its own.

phr-p04-v16.plain_english: Holding oneness with knowing fast — freedom while living.

phr-p05-v17.plain_english: From the middle's opening — knowing-bliss won.

phr-p05-v19.plain_english: From recalling oneness with knowing — samādhi ever risen.

essence: Free consciousness causes, unborrowing opens, divides by fitness, veils by tightening — descent promised.

sections.SUMMARY: Consciousness free causes the world's triple proving; by own will unborrowing she opens; fitness divides; tightening veils into knowerhood.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wonder: free, unborrowing, dividing, veiling. Opening relished.

essence: Mind tightened, knower measured, pentads stationed, schools seated on the descent.

sections.SUMMARY: Mind is tightened knowing; the māyā-knower measured to it; seven pentads station the fall; every school stands somewhere on the rungs.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wonder: mind to schools, all seated. Descent relished.

essence: Stained likeness keeps divine office: five acts done small is wandering.

sections.SUMMARY: Almost-knowing, power-tightened, stained — yet the fivefold office kept: done small, that doing is wandering.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: chained yet officed. Kept agency relished.

essence: Return climbs, burns, owns, holds fast — freedom alive.

sections.SUMMARY: Climb to knowing's seat turns climber to knowing; knowables burn; grown strong the world is owned; fast-held oneness is living freedom.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is steadfast exultation: climbed, burnt, owned, held. Return relished.

essence: Opening middle, given means, recalled oneness, become Śiva.

sections.SUMMARY: Middle opens into knowing-bliss; means given here; recalled oneness rises ever-waking samādhi; become Śiva.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is peace: opened, given, recalled, become. Arrival relished.

lines: Knowing stands free — the world's threefold turning
comes from it alone: arising, abiding, returning.
By her own will she blooms it, on her own ground —
no borrowed hands, no borrowed earth, in the opening.
One, yet many — where fit seer meets fit seen,
the same light breaks into shares.
A knot of knowing, yet a knower —
wearing a world shrunk to fit.
Made of that tightening — the māyā-measurer,
fit to a world of measures.
Almost knowing — but power drawn tight has stained it;
Chained, yet it keeps the fivefold office —
and call the world your own.
Grip oneness with knowing and never let go —
samādhi that never set, and never will.
